name: Helix Method Loop
description: Helix method loop: fuses Aegis's baseline-first, evidence-verified discipline with Ouroboros's clarify-seed-evaluate-evolve cycle. Pure method manual, zero config — no extra LLM setup, API keys, or daemons; quantitative gates are self-scored by the agent.
whenToUse: Disciplined coding: clarify vague requirements, write specs and acceptance criteria, root-cause debugging, verify evidence before claiming done, non-converging iterations, getting unstuck, long cross-session tasks, ADRs, retiring legacy code. Also on: helix, seed, grill, unstuck.

helix_gate.description: Helix quantitative gate calculator, five deterministic auditable modes. mode=ambiguity: ambiguity gate (≤0.2), clarity self-scores goal/constraints/success plus context for brownfield; mode=drift: drift gate (≤0.3), deviation scores goal/constraints/ontology; mode=loop: evolution-loop ruling from ac_total + ac_passed_history, auto-detects no-progress and diminishing returns, returns converged/continue/unstuck/cap-reached; mode=receipt: grades receipt confidence A/B/C deterministically from raw check facts (checks + uncovered) — grades must not be hand-assigned; mode=calibrate: pass the calibration ledger records to measure self-score optimism vs actual rework and get a tighten recommendation. Optional threshold passes a retro-calibrated stricter gate (tighten-only).

/properties/mode.description: ambiguity = ambiguity gate; drift = drift gate; loop = convergence/stall ruling; receipt = confidence grading; calibrate = self-score calibration stats

/properties/success.description: Success-criteria dimension score (required in ambiguity mode)

/properties/ontology.description: Ontology deviation score (required in drift mode)

/properties/context.description: Project-context dimension score (ambiguity mode, brownfield projects only)

/properties/brownfield.description: Whether this is a brownfield project (switches ambiguity weights and requires context)

/properties/threshold.description: Optional retro-calibrated stricter threshold, tighten-only (ambiguity 0.05–0.2, drift 0.1–0.3; values looser than the default are rejected)

/properties/ac_total.description: Total number of acceptance criteria (required in loop mode)

/properties/ac_passed_history.description: ACs passed at the end of each loop, in order; last entry is the current loop (required in loop mode)

/properties/repeated_same_error.description: Whether this loop hit essentially the same error as the previous one (spinning signal, loop mode)

/properties/oscillation.description: Whether fixes flip-flop between breaking A and breaking B (oscillation signal, loop mode)

/properties/checks.description: Raw facts of the checks run this round (receipt mode): name, exit_code (0 = pass), fresh (run after the change), scope (target / regression / other)

/properties/uncovered.description: Honest list of known uncovered areas (receipt mode; may be empty)

/properties/records.description: Calibration ledger records from .helix/calibration.jsonl (calibrate mode): ambiguity score at the time, actual loops used, final drift
